# pail

Pail is a small object store. You get a space, you PUT bytes, you GET them back. That is the product.

## read these

- docs/quickstart.md — first upload
- docs/auth.md — keys and space ids
- docs/errors.md — the codes, not the vibes
- openapi.yaml — if you are going to generate a client, start here, not the blog

## do not read

- there is no blog
- there is no "what is object storage" page
- there is no changelog written by marketing

## tools

stdio MCP: mcp_pail.py
tools: pail_whoami, pail_list_spaces, pail_put, pail_get, pail_explain_error
